description:
An effective firewall designed for Windows 7 and later versions, offering both simplicity and robustness.


- UI: Add Filter Simulator: Show the driver's decision on a connection (also from the Connections window).
- UI: Split the Statistics window into the Traffic and Connections windows.
- UI: Install/Remove the Service as Administrator from a non-admin UI (#472).
- UI: Password: Add "Unlock till" N minutes (#686).
- UI: Schedule: Set the Tasks' interval in minutes (#422).
- UI: TrayIcon: Check the Rules' actions by their enabled state (#678).
- UI: Backup: Restore the windows by the imported settings (#742).
- UI: Control: Add "rule on|off|report" and "rule set-text|get-text" commands (#727).
- UI: Control: Add "graph show|hide|switch" command (#743).
- UI: Control: "prog add": Open the Edit Program dialog without the Programs window (#680).
- Driver: Keep a wildcard program's paths on removal of a listed program (#696).
